method: Native serialization/generator static closure, read-only 11-file inventory, bounded CIL replay and independent typed-grammar feasibility. No production/parser/import edits.

results.name: All 11 original samples retain pinned hashes
Every one of 126 Move/Size inputs is StringLiteral, not NumericLiteral or arbitrary direct Expr
12 boundaries retain native AST; all six real mixed cases retain ordered siblings
Every scope binding in these cases is exactly GetWidget(one local path)
All observed local binding names are distinct after ASCII case folding per expression
Text-variable identities point back to their expression and do not override Target
No nonzero repeater scopes are hidden by the binding projection

motionExpression.bindings: Optional case-insensitive ASCII local-name -> {kind:widget,targetId}; resolve source path strictly before admission. Each expression gets fresh GetWidget snapshots. No arbitrary FCall/object/JS values in saved format.
motionExpression.nativeScalarReturn: StringLiteral substitution returns string for scalar number/bool; internal typed arithmetic is separate. Exact one-expression object result is a distinct native branch, outside these 126 Move/Size scalar inputs.

nativeValidation: RP11 witnessed carrier and reference tags; exact local object identity and property allowlists
GetWidget exactly one DiagramObjectPathLiteral; path: local object-id tag22, empty RDO/repeater paths, is-dummy false
Validate TextVariableIdentifier type, Expr back-reference, TargetOverride=false; nonzero repeater scope rejected until proven
Reject case-fold duplicate/reserved bindings and unresolved or omitted targets; no alias-to-This fallback
Original global variable provider checks document globals before built-ins; guard reserved-name collisions or implement exact precedence instead of silent normalization

builtins: This: current event source widget info, refreshed by provider
Target: current per-target action widget info
Window: eventInfo.window snapshot, derived from $(window).width()/height(), not page size
typedOperations: finite number toFixed(0) returning string for observed siblings
getters.limits: No arbitrary member access/call. Product numeric bounds and finite failures are independent policy, not claimed native limits.

boundary.ast: Recursive AND/OR or comparison with native direction plus full left/right MotionExpression; retain source order
boundary.projection: Independent deterministic typed STO generated from that AST, not serialized executable JS. Native RS57 flattens both AND and OR; sNQv only takes comparison leaves, preserving first-axis direction seed. Original boolean AST is evaluated first; only false applies projection.
boundary.axis: right subtracts Target.width from seed and limit; bottom subtracts Target.height. Left/right feed x; top/bottom feed y. Unspecified axis remains null.
boundary.gateCounterexample: For native top > 0 and candidate 0.5, condition is true: retain 0.5; do not unconditionally apply max(candidate,1).
boundary.realIncidence: 10 AND(>=,<=) DragX boundaries plus 2 Location top > 0; no real OR boundary witness

contract.atomicity: Store one Move/Resize action with ordered targets[] and per-target settings. Validate all events/cases/siblings/targets/scopes before native recovery; no child dropping, boundary dropping, alias erasure, or transient synthesized target IDs.
unresolved: D1dV regex/STO parsing internals not fully reimplemented; bounded proposed grammar only covers observed scalar expression texts
TargetOverride=true, compound/RDO/repeater scopes, local arbitrary FCalls/objects, Unicode culture folding and shadow collisions are not admitted by this proposal
No runtime queue/drag timing, nested fit measurement, fixed-position panel or full mixed-case behavior is claimed executed in this format task
Whole-object StringLiteral results and broad native coercion/NaN/Infinity behavior require separate runtime proof; finite arithmetic replay does not prove them
No original DLL or GUI execution; static CIL sinks and authored numeric contexts are explicitly not original rendered values
